Name: Revenue
Description: Income from the sale of goods and services, before costs.

Name: Recognized revenue
Description: Revenue earned in the period under the revenue recognition policy.

Name: Deferred revenue
Description: Amounts billed or received for goods or services not yet delivered.

Name: Cost center
Description: A unit of the company that budgets and costs are assigned to.

Name: Fiscal period
Description: A month of the fiscal year.

Name: Journal entry
Description: A posted accounting record with balanced debit and credit lines.

Name: Customer
Description: A party that has bought from Contoso or has an open contract to buy.

Name: Account
Description: The legal entity a customer contracts through. One customer can have several.

Name: Opportunity
Description: A potential sale tracked in the CRM from qualification to close.

Name: Order
Description: A confirmed request from a customer to buy products.

Name: Order line
Description: One product on an order, with quantity and net amount.

Name: Employee
Description: A person with an employment contract with a Contoso legal entity.

Name: Headcount
Description: The number of employees on the last working day of a month.

Name: Gross pay
Description: Pay before tax and deductions.

Name: Campaign
Description: A planned set of marketing activities with one goal and one budget.

Name: Web session
Description: A visit to a Contoso website that ends after 30 minutes without activity.

Name: Supplier
Description: An approved party that Contoso buys goods or services from.

Name: Stock on hand
Description: Units in a warehouse at the end of the day.

Name: Support case
Description: A customer request to the support team, from creation to closure.

Name: Customer satisfaction score
Description: The average survey score after a case closes, from 1 to 5.

Name: Calendar date
Description: A day in the Gregorian and fiscal calendars.

Name: Audit finding
Description: An issue raised by internal audit, with an owner and a due date.

Name: Personal data
Description: Any information that relates to an identified or identifiable person.

Name: Data subject request
Description: A request from a person to access, correct or delete their personal data.

Name: Booking
Description: A signed order before it ships. Use Order instead.
